ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_pairwise_reciprocal_advantage_logsigmoid
ir.intuition: Introduce a reciprocal scaling of the margin by the absolute advantage gap plus a small epsilon, converting difference magnitudes into stabilized inverse weights that shrink the penalty when advantage gaps are large, promoting emphasis on uncertain pairs. This shifts paradigm from margin-based scaling to importance-weighted margin loss using a reciprocal function.
ir.pseudocode:
adv_gap_abs_eps = max(abs(advantage_gap), epsilon)
scaled_margin = (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) / adv_gap_abs_eps
losses = -logsigmoid(alpha * scaled_margin)
loss = mean(weight * losses)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    epsilon = float(extra.get('epsilon', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('epsilon', 1e-4)))
    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    adv_gap_abs = ops.abs(adv_gap)
    adv_gap_abs_eps = ops.max(adv_gap_abs, ops.ones_like(adv_gap_abs) * epsilon)
    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    scaled_margin = ops.div(margin, adv_gap_abs_eps)
    scaled_margin = ops.mul(alpha, scaled_margin)
    losses = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(scaled_margin))
    if weight is not None:
        losses = ops.mul(losses, weight)
    return ops.mean(losses)
